basis: Disorder of the heart's sinoatrial node and cardiac conduction system.
Acute leukemia involving hematopoietic blasts and bone marrow; no additional organ involvement established as common.
Bilateral collapse of the nasal alae affects the nasal airway, which belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Mitochondrial disorder with spastic cerebellar degeneration; neurogenic bladder in 13/23 (~57%); scoliosis 30-79%. Hearing loss 3/23 is below threshold.
Immune response to inhaled antigens directly causes chronic lung inflammation and fibrosis.
Inherited purine-metabolism defect causes erythrocyte destruction. Hyperbilirubinemia reflects hemolysis; the definition excludes other tissue involvement.
Severe neurodevelopmental syndrome; scoliosis and hypodontia 80-99%; microphthalmia and iris coloboma 30-79%. External ear shape changes do not establish hearing damage.
Digestive-system tumor umbrella; gastrointestinal origin applies broadly. Hepatobiliary origin is restricted to a subset.
Benign tumor of the lip, an oral structure within the gastrointestinal axis.
LRRK2-associated Parkinson disease causes degeneration of central motor pathways; dementia and hyposmia also fall within the neurologic axis.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction; chronic middle-ear disease with hearing impairment affects >30% in primary ciliary dyskinesia. CFAP46-specific frequency is uncertain.
Erythrocytosis provides the defining blood axis; pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma susceptibility does not establish current endocrine-organ damage.
Paroxysmal movement disorder defined by centrally mediated chorea, athetosis and dystonia.
Developmental impairment commonly accompanies clinically significant 11q deletions. Platelet, cardiac and dental defects depend on the deleted interval and are not generalized across this umbrella.
Inflammation of the abdominal peritoneum. Infection or an autoimmune mechanism is not required by the umbrella definition.
Carcinoma arising in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the 13 axes.
Primary carcinoma arising centrally within jaw bone from odontogenic epithelial remnants; oral mucosal involvement is not required.
TCAP-associated hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; supplied phenotypes establish cardiac disease without skeletal muscle involvement.
Monogenic disorders of cardiac rhythm and conduction.
Inherited immune-mediated cutaneous lupus with persistent acral inflammatory lesions; common extracutaneous organ damage is not established.
Bacterial infection defines the mechanism; no single anatomical organ is affected across most of this broad group.
Renal arterial narrowing or occlusion causes kidney-mediated hypertension. Renin signaling does not establish a separate endocrine disorder.
Benign myofibroblastic connective-tissue neoplasm, classified on the soft-tissue musculoskeletal axis; the umbrella includes sites beyond breast.
Bacterial cellulitis of the mouth floor and adjacent submandibular spaces; airway compromise is a complication rather than defining airway infection.
Limb and skeletal malformations define the syndrome; cognitive impairment and ptosis each 30-79%. Skin hyperextensibility alone does not establish damage; dental defects are <30%.
